The absolute inset overlay renders <AppText weight='bold' fontSize 30>{level}%</AppText> + <AppText fontSize 10 secondary>{Math.round(rangeDisplay)} {distanceUnit}</AppText>, matching the web text-3xl level + text-[10px] secondary range.

The h-11 w-11 rounded-full ghost button, disabled-when-loading, active:scale-95 (only with onPress), and opacity-50-when-loading are all reproduced; the optional text-[8px] label is rendered below the glyph; aria-label -> accessibilityLabel.

L250-302 WatchPWAMeta(): the web useEffect that injects/restores <meta apple-mobile-web-app-capable=yes>, <meta apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style=black>, <meta theme-color=#000000> and <link rel=manifest href=/watch-manifest.json> (with full existed/previous-value restore cleanup) is ported verbatim BUT guarded by getDocument(): it feature-detects globalThis.document (+head/querySelector/createElement). On react-native-web the exact DOM logic runs; on bare native getDocument() returns null and the effect is a no-op (PWA meta/manifest are a browser-only concern). Returns null in all cases. Documented as the contract rule 7 native-safe unavailable state.

L333-343 formatRelativeTime(isoTimestamp): ported verbatim — '' for empty; <60s 'just now'; <3600s '{m}m ago'; <86400s '{h}h ago'; else '{d}d ago'.

Lint/type notes (behaviour-preserving): React Native primitives only (View/ScrollView/Pressable/ActivityIndicator/StyleSheet/useWindowDimensions); static styles live in StyleSheet, only genuinely dynamic values (segment colour/left/top/width/transform, badge/tint colours, shell minHeight) are inline (the same dynamic-style pattern the shared native RadialGauge port uses). DOM access in WatchPWAMeta/readVehicleIdParam is runtime feature-detection via typed globalThis shims (no DOM module import), consistent with the AIWatchFaceNLResponse native port.
